sets_doc.asg8: Apocalypse Sword God ch.8 (KaiScans, 1280w webtoon strips). Guards: ghost lettering framing translations (fixed r17-r19), blue skill panels erase-by-strip + left alignment, jagged shout bubbles, TL/N captions, credit page dense panels, edge slivers, near-black ink #0c1924 vs the title-art saturation gate.
sets_doc.ch35: Chapter 35 set (900w WEBP, mixes a 16000px strip with short slices). Material the r20+ renderer revisions were tuned against; locks their current behaviour.
sets_doc.asg123: Apocalypse Sword God ch.123 (Raven Scans, 800w colour manhua). Added 2026-08-15 from the same audit as kd53: 39 of 98 changed bands were defective. Where kd53 covers colour manhwa, this set covers the manhua failure modes — flat zero-variance fills swallowing whole panels, text placed in the gutter between two bubbles instead of inside either, and erase rectangles decoupled from where the translation actually lands.
sets_doc.kd53: Kidnapped Dragons ch.53 (Raven Scans, 800w colour manhwa). Added 2026-08-15 after a full-chapter audit found rendering defects on 46 of 129 changed bands. Colour webtoon art is what the earlier sets lack: glowing narration boxes, oval bubbles with neon rims, gradient bubble interiors and outlined lettering on grey — every one of which defeats a guard that greyscale strips never exercised.
